_comment: Event contest definitions for cogs/contests.py. Times are local wall-clock in 'timezone' (DST handled by the zone). Windows: submit_opens_at < submit_closes_at <= vote_opens_at < vote_closes_at; contests must not overlap. id is 1-24 of a-z 0-9 - and is part of every payout case id, so never rename one that has run. reward_lane must be a key of contests.LANES. Edit, then restart Cielago.

contests.title: Night of Costumes
contests.prompt: Post a screenshot of your strangest costume or your spookiest base.
